name: 85282 · Tempe, AZ
findings: ZIP 85282 (Tempe) has 242 nonprofit organizations. 122 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 104 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85282 (Tempe) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
